description_en: Queries the cluster backup sets for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance that uses cloud disks
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版云盘版分片集群的集群备份集列表
name: DescribeClusterBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster backup
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页号。默认值为1，取值范围为正整数
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30 (Default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

This parameter is invalid if you specify the BackupId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter is invalid if you specify the BackupId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the information about the child nodes in the cluster backup. Valid values:

true: Returns only the basic information about the cluster backup, not the backup information about all child nodes.

false (Default): Returns the backup information about all child nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询集群备份下的子节点信息。取值说明：
true：只返回集群备份基本信息，不返回全量的子节点的备份信息。
false（默认 ）：返回全量的子节点的备份信息
parameters.name: is_only_get_cluster_back_up

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance resides.

This parameter is required when you query the backup sets of a released instance.

This parameter is required when you query geo-redundant backups
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在地域。

查询已释放实例的备份集列表式，该参数必填。
查询异地备份时，该参数必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where the geo-redundant backup resides.

This parameter is required when you query geo-redundant backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份所在地域。

查询异地备份时，该参数必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup job
parameters.name: backup_job_id

ClusterBackups.description_en: The details of the cluster backup sets. A cluster backup contains the backup sets of all nodes
ClusterBackups.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

items.description_en: The details of the cluster backup sets. A cluster backup contains the backup sets of all nodes
items.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

AttachLogStatus.description_en:
The status of the attached log backup. Valid values:

Init: initialization.

No_Need: No attached log backup is available.

Running: The attached log backup is in progress.

Ready: The attached log backup is complete.

Failed: The attached log backup failed.

If the value of the ClusterBackupStatus parameter is OK, it only indicates that the full backup was successful. For a cluster instance for which log backup is enabled, the attached log backup must be complete before you can perform a point-in-time restore or ensure data consistency
AttachLogStatus.description_zh:
备份的状态，取值如下：
Init：初始化。
No_Need：无附加日志备份。
Running：附加日志备份中。
Ready：附加日志备份完成。
Failed：附加日志备份失败。

当ClusterBackupStatus参数（集群备份集的状态）的值为OK时，仅表示全量备份阶段执行成功了，对于开启了日志备份的集群实例，想要使用按时间点恢复或满足一致性恢复的效果时，需要附加日志备份完成

BackupExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the backup expires. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC.

<notice>

A value of "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z" indicates that the backup is permanently retained.

</notice>
BackupExpireTime.description_zh: 备份过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z"表示长期保留。>

Backups.description_en: The backup sets of each child node in the cluster backup
Backups.description_zh: 单个集群备份集下，各个子节点的备份集集合

items.description_en: The backup sets of each child node in the cluster backup
items.description_zh: 单个集群备份集下，各个子节点的备份集集合

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public URL from which you can download the backup file. If the backup file is unavailable for download, an empty string is returned
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 备份文件的外网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回为空字符串

BackupEndTime.description_en: The time when the backup finished. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en: The internal URL from which you can download the backup file. If the backup file is unavailable for download, an empty string is returned
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh: 内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则返回空值

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file, in bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The time when the backup started. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:

Success: The backup is successful.

Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，取值说明：
Success：备份成功。
Failed：备份失败
